notes.title: Quality of life changes!
notes.notes:
WarpThrough has just received a few QoL updates:

[list]
[*] Arcade mode has everything unlocked from the start
[*] Hardcore Hero and GR8 achievement are less impossible to obtain
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Permanent price drop!
notes.notes:
Hello dimension hoppers,

It’s been a month since WarpThrough’s release, and one thing I’ve heard a number of times is that people find the game too expensive to try out.

That's good to know!

After taking a step back and considering what I could do, I’ve decided to lower the default price of WarpThrough from 10 to 6.5 euros. 
Thank you so much to everyone who has already bought the game! I hope you understand why I’m lowering it now, and I hope you’ve had a good time playing WarpThrough so far :)
If you know anyone who wanted to get it, but found it’s previous price point a bit too high - please let them know of the price drop ^^

Thank you for your support,

Ramon

notes.title: Demo released, and this week's goal!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing last week's challenge!
We managed to hit 500, so the goal of 1000 last week has been split in two. If we can get 500 again this time, we'll unlock a new unique character as future content!

I've also released a demo for WarpThrough, so if any of your friends are doubting whether they should get it - let them give it a go there! And if they buy it within the next 20 hours, they'll still get the 10% discount too :)

For more information on how the weekly challenge can unlock new content, [url=http://roofkatgames.com/warpthefuture]click here![/url]

Cheers,

Ramon

notes.title: WarpThrough release, Warp The Future, and reddit AMA!
notes.notes:
After 18 months of work, WarpThrough released on Steam yesterday!
To celebrate, I'll be doing an AMA on reddit at 18:00 CET tonight. So if you have any questions, feel free to ask me there!

On top of that, if you play WarpThrough's Weekly Challenge this week, you can unlock future content with your highscore! If the sum of everyone's score on the leaderboard reaches over a thousand this week, I will be adding new characters in a free update. Find more information about that here: http://roofkatgames.com/warpthefuture

Thanks for checking out the game, and I hope you enjoy it :)

- Ramon

notes.title: WarpThrough first patch (1.0.20)
notes.notes:
First patch after WarpThrough's initial release, Build number 1.0.20. Includes the following fixes:
[list]
[*]Single forcefield will now correctly display text when you can create it
[*]Some minor text errors fixed
[*]Credits improved
[/list]

If you encounter any other issues, please let me know in the discussions :)

notes.title: WarpThrough releases this December!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0Q9rZ73PJWA;full][/previewyoutube]

After one and a half years of working on it, I’ll be releasing WarpThrough this December! 
I’m sure you’ll understand I am thrilled and terrified at the same time ^^’

Let's see where this journey goes from here!

- Ramon

notes.title: Join the discord & playtest the Beta!
notes.notes:
Hello users of Steam!

For the past 15 months I’ve been working hard on my fast, arcade-style platformer WarpThrough. I’ve been fleshing out it’s gameplay, and working hard on a story for you to play through. In these past few months a lot has been coming together, and soon I will get to nervously hover over the ‘publish’ button to release it!

Before that however, I could really use your help. I played WarpThrough so much that it’s hard for me to look at it objectively, and having some fresh eyes see what I created would be very useful. If you would like to have an early look at WarpThrough and don’t mind sitting through a few bugs, please fill in the form at [url=https://forms.gle/XanFYS71QWDtSKvJ8]playtest.warpthrough.com[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34619979/a9bf25bfaef8052fd31c4f632cb7f9ede66598be.png[/img]

If you’d like to get in touch with me and others interested in WarpThrough, please join the Roofkat discord at [url=https://discord.gg/AwnGgzy]discord.warpthrough.com[/url]. Hope to see you there :D

Oh, and if you could wishlist WarpThrough on Steam to tell it’s almighty algorithm to give this game a chance, that would be amazing too ^^ 

Thanks a lot!

Ramon
